headline: Executive order directs federal agencies on how to handle regulations that significantly affect energy supply, distribution, or use.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets rules for how federal agencies deal with regulations that could have a large effect on the nation's energy supply, distribution, or use. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take certain actions when a regulation could significantly affect energy supply, distribution, or use.
Regulations affecting their industry are covered by the order's special handling.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 18, 2001; no separate effective date was provided.
